name: captains_house
notes: A Federal sea captain's house 13 m wide by 11 m deep, three storeys of red brick with granite quoins, lintels and steps, a fanlit front door and four brick chimneys, under a low hipped slate roof with a railed plank widow's walk 4 m by 3 m on top, reached from the attic by a stair through a roof hatch. Faces local -Z: central hall with three stacked flights and four rooms a floor with fireplaces on the end walls; carves nothing.
